abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击与重击向敌人喷射强腐蚀性酸液，施加强酸 (Acid Burn)，每秒溶解敌方护甲并造成持续伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged and Heavy Attacks spray corrosive acid, inflicting Acid Burn which steadily melts enemy Armor and deals damage over time.

abilities.desc_zh: 受到近战物理攻击时，25% 几率将强酸飞溅至攻击者身上，削减其护甲评级 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: Taking physical melee hits has a 25% chance to splash acid onto the attacker, reducing their Armor by {{var_1}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击与重击命中时有 35% 概率施加一层酸化减益，造成攻击力 35% 的伤害，持续 5 秒，并施加 10% 的破甲减益，持续 5 秒（上限 3 层）。当敌方身上存在酸化减益时，酸雨的所有攻击造成的伤害增加 20%。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged and Heavy Attacks: 35% chance to inflict Acid, dealing 35% Attack over 5s and inflicting a 10% Armor Break Debuff for 5s (Max Stacks: 3). While the opponent has an Acid Debuff, all of Acid Storm's attacks deal +20% damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 战斗开始时以及施放特殊攻击后，酸雨周身环绕酸性气溶胶 5 秒。若在这 5 秒内未被敌人击中且未进行防御，气溶胶冷凝为 [2 - 4] 个酸性护盾增益（每个护盾将单次受击伤害限制为对手攻击力的 70%，被击中时消耗一个护盾并对攻击者施加一层酸化减益）；若在气溶胶持续时间内施放特殊攻击，该特殊攻击施加的酸化减益持续时间延长 [50% - 100%]。
abilities.desc_en: At battle start and after every Special, surrounds himself with acidic vapor for 5s. If not hit and not blocking during this time, condenses into [2 - 4] Acid Shield Buffs (each caps incoming hit damage to 70% opponent Attack, and inflicts 1 Acid Debuff when consumed); if a Special is launched during the vapor, its Acid duration is extended by [50% - 100%].

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击命中 70% 几率施加一层酸化减益，造成攻击力 40% 的伤害，持续 4 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Last hit: 70% chance to inflict Acid, dealing 40% Attack over 4s.

abilities.desc_zh: 每一击有 70% 几率施加一层酸化减益，造成攻击力 50% 的伤害，持续 5 秒；并有 45% 概率施加 20% 的破甲减益，持续 6 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Each hit has a 70% chance to inflict Acid dealing 50% Attack over 5s; 45% chance to inflict a 20% Armor Break Debuff for 6s.

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击 100% 几率施加 2 层酸化减益，造成攻击力 80% 的伤害，持续 6.5 秒；并施加 30% 的破甲减益，持续 8 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Last hit: 100% chance to inflict 2 stacks of Acid dealing 80% Attack over 6.5s; and inflicts a 30% Armor Break Debuff for 8s.

abilities.desc_zh: 与离子风、新星风同队时，全队元素减益持续时间延长 {{var_2}}。
abilities.desc_en: Elemental debuffs last {{var_2}} longer when teamed with Ion Storm and Nova Storm.

abilities.desc_zh: 与红蜘蛛、闹翻天、惊天雷同队时，远程伤害提升 {{var_3}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_3}} Ranged Damage when paired with Starscream, Skywarp, or Thundercracker.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_4}} 酸液腐蚀伤害。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_4}} Acid Damage.
